source: Watson, Lomas & Buswell (2021) Energy and Buildings 238, 110777 (heat-pump households heat longer: +8 % annual heat, 12 % lower peak, 67 % lower ramp than gas-boiler households in a cold year); Halloran (2024) DPhil thesis, University of Oxford, chapters 5-6 (building-fabric heating flexibility as thermal energy storage in a PyPSA capacity-expansion model).

daily_total_source_options.ubem: each day's space heat is the calibrated hourly model's day total for that dwelling (fabric, weather and calibrated behaviour), re-shaped within the day by the trial profile of the day's temperature band
daily_total_source_options.watson: the day totals follow Watson's piece-wise linear regression against the effective outdoor temperature, scaled to the dwelling's calibrated annual

flexibility.specific_heat_capacity_note: SAP medium thermal mass parameter, used by Halloran (2024) section 5.2.4 to convert floor area to heat capacity
flexibility.heat_pump_thermal_capacity_note: Halloran (2024) equation 6.9, average thermal heat-pump capacity used for the flexibility charging link; the tool also reports the sized ASHP capacity of the scenario
